selected_evidence.summary: Shows the persistent GRUB setting, successful configuration generation, `audit=1` in all generated entries, and the post-reboot kernel command line. Kernel messages report `audit_enabled=1`.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, node1 runs Ubuntu 24.04 with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic.

Healthy baseline boot ID was dfeb3b70-bc1e-4ce9-90d0-9c9c853416e7; systemd acknowledged the safe reboot; the new boot ID is a77b756c-1bcc-44fa-8cb4-d3341c54ed68; post-reboot state is running with a writable root filesystem and recovered persistent GRUB configuration.

commands.command: printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"; printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'kernel='; uname -r; printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$NAME" "$VERSION_ID"; printf 'cmdline='; cat /proc/cmdline; printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running 2>&1; printf 'rootfs='; findmnt -n -o SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /
